method: Candidate links from public SimplifyJobs GitHub lists, then actual approved Greenhouse robots/page fetch through unchanged app guards. Original public title/og metadata/logo/header/description excerpted; forms/buttons/scripts/styles/SVG excluded. Raw originals remain ignored locally. Manual visible-text review before first prediction, applying the existing internship-Unverified rubric. No model/Google/applicant/owner DB/form calls.
limits: Targeted early-career controls, not random or multi-ATS validation.
One explicit New Grad positive; three internships remain Unverified, not personal eligibility decisions.
No full exact start day/deadline. June/summer/year windows and corporate dates do not become job dates.
Right-to-work statements do not establish visa sponsorship offer/refusal.
Location labels retain literal platform text, including employer suffixes; not independent geographic precision.
Axon talent-community and Blenheim/Fospha captures excluded before prediction because publisher/employer brand identity was not resolved; this selection limitation is explicit.
EU Greenhouse links were not fetched under unchanged host policy.
